facts.text: John is interested in improving education and infrastructure in his community.

evidence.quote: I'm passionate about improving education and infrastructure in our community. Those are my main focuses.

Growing up, I saw how lack of education and crumbling infrastructure affected my neighborhood. I don't want future generations to go through that, so I think schools and infrastructure should be funded properly.

facts.text: John mentioned a photo of a school that received funding after improvements.

evidence.quote: Here's a pic of a school last year, after they got the funding.
